topic: Theory: Zunesha's punishment links to Joy Boy and the Void Century, not a random crime
title: Zunesha's Crime Is The Void Century Clue Nobody Reads
description: Zunesha has carried Zou for centuries as punishment for an unnamed crime, and it was tied to Joy Boy. Here's my read on why that crime points at the Void Century. Do you agree?
comment: Zunesha's crime: did it betray Joy Boy, or protect him? Pick a side.

lines.text: Zunesha is carrying an entire island as punishment, and nobody asks for what.

shot.fallback: giant elephant carrying an island on its back

lines.text: That one detail might be the best Void Century clue in One Piece.

shot.fallback: colossal elephant walking through the sea
elephant giant with a forest island

lines.text: Zunesha carries Zou on its back as punishment for a crime the story never names.

shot.fallback: giant elephant with an island on its back

lines.text: And in chapter 1040, Momonosuke reveals Zunesha was Joy Boy's companion centuries ago.

shot.fallback: dragon boy talking about a giant elephant

lines.text: Now remember chapter 628. Joy Boy left an apology for a promise he couldn't keep.

shot.search: Joy Boy apology Fish-Man Island Poneglyph
shot.fallback: ancient stone with writing on a sea floor

lines.text: So a broken promise, and a punished companion. That's not a coincidence.

shot.fallback: ancient hero and a giant elephant
giant elephant under a dark sky

lines.text: Zunesha wasn't punished for betraying Joy Boy. It was punished for standing with him.

shot.fallback: elephant bowing before a smiling hero

lines.text: People say its crime could be anything unrelated. But it's chained to the one man the World Government erased.

shot.fallback: giant elephant with chains and ancient ruins

lines.text: Chapter 802 introduced it as a mystery, and I think Oda has been paying it off ever since.

shot.fallback: island on an elephant at sunset

lines.text: A creature that stood with a man history erased.

shot.fallback: giant elephant and a silhouette of a man

lines.text: And that's the crime nobody asks about...
